_why: The device gate's checks in 5 groups, each group on its own Simulator in its own job (.github/workflows/device-gate.yml matrix; the free plan runs 5 macOS jobs at once). Every check starts from its own clean app state, so a group is only a way to share a booted Simulator: no check leans on another. Every Simulator check and the store-build smoke check is in exactly one group (tests/device-gate-groups.test.ts).
